hackathons.prize: 总奖金 $1,500：第一名 $600、第二名 $500、第三名 $400；前三名另各得一把 Monad 定制机械键盘
hackathons.summary: OpenBuild 发布、Monad Foundation 为规则与版权方的纯线下一日黑客松，2026 年 11 月 21 日（周六）09:00–21:00 在广州举行，具体场馆报名成功后才公布。主题是在高性能并行 EVM Layer 1 公链 Monad 上构建 dApp 原型、用 Testnet 实验：上午 Monad 101 工作坊，中午组队，12:00–18:30 开发，当天 18:30 提交截止，19:00 Demo 展示，获奖者由现场观众投票选出。单人或组队，每队最多 3 人，有报名筛选，面向 Web2/Web3 开发者；费用与报名截止官方未公布，目前报名进行中。组队、提交与评选在 MOJO 官方活动页（报名后解锁）：https://mojo.devnads.com/events/18
hackathons.summary_en: A one-day, fully in-person hackathon published by OpenBuild, with rules and IP held by the Monad Foundation, held in Guangzhou on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026, 09:00-21:00; the exact venue is revealed only after a successful application. The theme is building dApp prototypes on Monad, a high-performance parallel-EVM Layer 1, experimenting on testnet: a Monad 101 workshop in the morning, team formation at noon, building from 12:00 to 18:30, submissions closing at 18:30 the same day, demos at 19:00, and winners chosen by on-site audience vote. Solo entries or teams of up to 3; applications are screened; open to Web2 and Web3 developers. The organizer has not published a fee or a registration deadline; registration is currently open. Team formation, submissions and judging run on the official MOJO event page (unlocked after registration): https://mojo.devnads.com/events/18
hackathons.prize_en: $1,500 total: $600 for 1st place, $500 for 2nd, $400 for 3rd; the top three also each receive a custom Monad mechanical keyboard

The 60,000 USDC pool splits into 29,000 USDC in ecosystem growth awards ranked by on-chain interaction data (number of interacting Agent ID addresses, transaction volume) and 29,000 USDC in innovation awards scored by judges (Agent ID integration depth 30%, practicality 25%, completion 25%, innovation 20%), which require a live product and at least 30 Agent ID addresses interacting with the contracts during the submission period; plus a 2,000 USDC community promotion award. Each category takes a top 10, and winning projects also receive a two-digit Agent ID claim spot. No registration needed; submit project details during the submission period, 2026-11-18 08:00 UTC to 2026-12-09 08:00 UTC.
